F-INCIDENT.note: Commercial support acknowledgment is not financial recovery or reconciliation. All actions scoped to allowed incident; no automatic grant from read access.

F-REPORT.note: Report enum does not grant access. Intersection of endpoint role,book permission,tenant/object and data-use rights;include_sensitive requires independent documented permission.

F-RELEASE.note: Author cannot self-review where the released governance policy requires independence. Being owner does not waive rights,merchant/platform or authority gates.

F-RECOVERY-OPS.note: Publisher_operator may inspect permitted evidence but cannot promote sites or acquire private credentials. This form prepares a card,not a live promotion command.

F-ACCESS.note: No public signup role selection. Invitation scope verified;last owner lockout prevented;operator role never creates private owner auth.

F-PUBLISH-ACTION.note: Reconcile remains an observation operation;resubmission requires actual resolved outcome and exact authorized action,never a generic retry.
